title: Elev8 Silicone Joint Plug
description:
Elev8 Silicone Joint Plug
These handy joint plugs are used to trap in liquids in your water pipes. They can be used to stop spill and can also be used during the cleaning process when shaking up your cleaning solution. They work with 10mm, 14mm and also 18mm female joints. With 10mm joints it is only the very tip that is inserted. With 14mm, the joint will seal on the upper section of the plug. And with 18mm, the plug needs to be inverted and the very top will seal the joint closed.
Included
1 x Elev8 Silicone Joint Plug (Choose Colour)
